skills.description: Automatically add navigation bookmarks / table of contents to books that lack them. Use when a user wants clickable outlines or TOC added to a PDF, EPUB, or TXT file (e.g. '给这本 PDF 加目录', '这本书没有书签', '把 TXT 转成带目录的 EPUB', 'auto-generate bookmarks for this ebook'). Handles PDF (font-size heuristic outline for text-based PDFs; OCR reverse-lookup for image-only/scanned PDFs; TOC-offset mode for scanned PDFs that print a page-numbered table of contents), EPUB (rebuild NCX/Nav from h1-h4), and TXT (chapter detection to bookmarked EPUB).
